create_ensemble_algorithm: create an EnsembleAlgorithm instance with a map of group names to Algorithm objects for multi-agent RL
get_loss_from_ensemble: get the loss module for a specific agent group by delegating to the underlying algorithm in the ensemble
get_parameters_from_ensemble: get the trainable parameters for a specific group by delegating to the underlying algorithm in the ensemble
create_ensemble_config: create an EnsembleAlgorithmConfig with a map of group names to AlgorithmConfig objects and validate on_policy consistency
get_algorithm_from_config: get an EnsembleAlgorithm instance from an EnsembleAlgorithmConfig by matching group names to environment groups
